On an upbeat watch, rules for the dispatchers
This section explains the steps for the whole desk

Companion Animal Travel Desk procedures

The purpose of this section is to keep animal travel clear, kind, and safe for every booking handled by Aurelia Skyways. The desk gives simple guidance, checks each record with care, and keeps the tone calm from first contact to arrival.

When a traveler asks about bringing a pet, staff should listen closely, confirm the animal details, and explain the next steps in plain words. For larger dogs, the fee note must be shared exactly as issued by the system. <<FACT F057>> Each file should also show the agreed travel plan, the cage or carrier details, and any notes that help the cabin team monitor the animal during flight. If the traveler is unsure, the dispatcher should slow down, repeat the key points, and keep the language friendly and direct.

Before travel, staff must verify the health paperwork and check that the animal is fit for carriage. Cats need a valid health certificate on file before approval can move ahead. <<FACT F079>> If anything looks incomplete, the case should be paused and sent for review instead of guessed at or rushed through. The desk should never promise an exception without the proper review path.

If a concern comes up on the day of travel, staff should use the calm stepwise review and keep the traveler informed in steady language. Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and the cabin team should be briefed with only the facts needed to do the job well. For questions beyond the desk, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at Aurelia Skyways.
